page.overview:
Who is Apyaahi?

Apyaahi is a non-playable character in Final Fantasy XIV. She is the founder of Passage of the Unbound, the group of antagonists during the role quests in the Dawntrail expansion.

Apyaahi's past is largely unknown but she did mention that she lived with her sisters who got drunk on a regular basis and resented that she had a "role" chosen for her amongst her people. A role which she had no say in choosing and no chance to change, leading her to resent rules and laws in general.

For an unknown crime, Apyaahi was banished from her home, forcing her to find a new home for herself. However, Apyaahi couldn't reconcile with the basic fact that all lands would have their own set of rules, including that she had to pay for basic lodgings which was something she claimed wasn't a custom amongst her people. As she traveled from land to land, trying to live the way she wanted, Apyaahi got more and more frustrated with all the rules and restrictions, eventually finding her way to Tural. She hoped that the New World would finally be the place she could do as she wished but was disappointed that it was no different to any other land with rules. After losing her tent for "vagrancy", Apyaahi decided to end all the rules and restrictions, thereby founding the Passage of the Unbound.

Apyaahi observed various people around the world and wrote an invitation to five individuals to join her villainous organization, arranging the meeting at the Xbalyav T've in Tuliyollal. The guests were: Leophyne from Ishgard, Virazahn from Radz-at-Han, Samidare from Doma, Ellerete from La Noscea, Chalteaufite from Ala Mhigo. With everyone reunited, Apyaahi explained that the Passage of the Unbound was a secret organization with the intention of spreading discord throughout the world. Apyaahi persuades the guests to join her, explaining that with the help of Tural's sacred relics they would have the power they needed to achieve their goal. With the organization founded, Apyaahi instructs each member on how to infiltrate the clans throughout Tural and steal their respective treasures..}}
